jobs.title: Director, Product & Commercial Marketing
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on B2B marketing leader with a proven track record of marketing complex products and services in aviation, aerospace, industrial manufacturing, logistics, defense, or other highly technical industries. The ideal candidate brings experience marketing complex products or services within aviation, aerospace, industrial manufacturing, logistics, defense, or another global technical industry and has a proven ability to independently develop and execute integrated marketing programs that drive business growth.

This position works closely with the VP of Corporate Marketing and the Corporate Marketing team to drive awareness, demand generation, and customer engagement across AAR's commercial aviation aftermarket businesses. Responsibilities include developing marketing strategy, leading integrated campaigns, optimizing digital channels, creating sales enablement tools, measuring performance, and strengthening the Company's overall marketing infrastructure and processes.

What Will You Be Responsible For

Product and commercial marketing:

Collaborate with business segment SMEs to identify growth opportunities, align marketing priorities, and support strategic business objectives.
Support revenue growth by developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that increase market awareness, generate demand, strengthen customer engagement, and enable commercial teams.
Work with sales and business development team members across the Company to lead positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for commercial products and services across AAR's Parts, Distribution, and Repair businesses.
Partner with Sales, Business Development, and Brand Manager to develop customer-facing messaging, presentations, case studies, videos, competitive positioning, and other sales enablement tools that support pipeline growth.
Work closely with AAR Corporate Communications to provide topics and campaigns focused on commercial offerings for AAR’s social media channels that align with campaigns and new offerings.
Negotiate with outside agencies / vendors and suppliers, including budget planning and monitoring.
Measure and communicate campaign effectiveness, marketing contribution, engagement, and ROI, using data to continuously optimize programs and recommendations.
Assist with on-site tradeshow support as needed.

Branding/Corporate Identity (CI)

Ensure CI standards and messaging with the Brand Manager on Company-wide materials and templates.
Oversee coordination of monthly global Corporate Marketing and Communications meeting with representatives from every Business segment, core teams, and region to advocate for the Company’s brand standards including logo usage, colors, etc., for signage, presentations and all marketing materials.

Website / digital initiatives

Improve the product and commercial content strategy for AAR's digital channels, ensuring website content, landing pages, and customer-facing experiences accurately reflect market positioning, offerings, and brand standards.
Collaborate with internal and external partners to

develop and optimize digital marketing initiatives, including search, social, paid media, email marketing, and campaign landing pages.

Advertising

Work with vendors to ensure ad fulfillment, proper media buys, overall strategy, and manage invoices.
Work with Brand Manager to create digital ads for Corporate, and specific products and services for the above-mentioned business segments.
Coordinate, measure, and communicate ad metrics in coordination with ad agency to maximize ROI and demonstrate positive impact on business.

Video / Photography

Develop scripts and coordinate assets as needed for vendors on video and photography shoots.
Coordinate with external photographers and videographers.
Identify and coordinate high-resolution photos for marketing and further usage.
Other duties as assigned.

What You Need To Be Successful In This Role

Strong writing skills for print and web, close attention to detail, and can balance multiple projects at one time.
Hands-on, strategic B2B marketer who can quickly understand complex technical offerings and translate them into compelling customer value propositions
Experience leading product marketing initiatives across multiple business lines, partnering closely with sales and business leaders, managing external agencies, and developing integrated campaigns that support revenue growth.
Experience marketing complex products or services within aviation, aerospace, defense, industrial manufacturing, logistics, transportation, or other highly technical global B2B industries is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, global organization.

Education And/or Experience

10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience.
5+ years leading product marketing, solution marketing, or integrated marketing programs.
Demonstrated success marketing complex technical products, services, or solutions.
Experience partnering directly with commercial and business development teams.
Experience managing agencies, external vendors, and marketing budgets.
Background in aviation, aerospace, defense, industrial manufacturing, logistics, or other global B2B industries strongly preferred.
Bachelor of Arts degree (B.A.) or Bachelor of Science degree (B.S.) from four-year college or university; Journalism, Communications, Public Relations and/or Marketing major/degree preferred
Master of Arts/Master of Business Administration degree a plus
Experience with Adobe Creative Suite/Cloud, Microsoft Copilot, SharePoint
Experience using a website content management system (CMS) PhotoShelter/ThirdLight, and paid Meta campaigns / digital advertisement a plus

The rewards of your career at AAR go far beyond just your salary:

Competitive salary and bonus package
Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage
.401(k) retirement plan with company match
Generous paid time off program
Professional development and career advancement opportunities

Physical Demands/Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to sit, stand, bend, reach and move about the facility.
The environmental characteristic for this position is an office setting.
Candidates should be able to adapt to a traditional business environment.

AAR provides accommodation in accordance with applicable laws through all stages of the hiring process. If you require accommodation for any part of the application and/or hiring process, please advise Human Resources.

Compensation

The anticipated salary range for this position is $127,000 to $145,000
annually. This range reflects the base salary for candidates who meet the requirements of the role, including experience, education, and location. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for a bonus. AAR offers a competitive benefits package, including medical/dental/vision/life/and AD&D insurance, 401(k) savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holiday pay, as well as opportunities for professional development and growth.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

jobs.title: VP of Financial Product Services
jobs.description:
Company Description
Ayudhya Fund Management Co., Ltd. (AYF) is a leading asset management company in Thailand, offering a full range of investment products and services to individual and institutional clients. Established in 1996 and now a subsidiary of Bank of Ayudhya PCL, AYF benefits from the backing of one of Thailand’s largest commercial banks. The company has grown through strategic partnerships and acquisitions to strengthen its market position and operational efficiency. Guided by a vision to be a lifelong asset management company, AYF focuses on enriching and enduring investment solutions. AYF is committed to developing and retaining top investment talent to deliver competitive products, outstanding service, and stable returns.
Role Description
The VP of Financial Product Services is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading the design, management, and enhancement of investment and financial products across AYF’s portfolio. This role oversees end-to-end product lifecycle management, including market analysis, product strategy, development, launch, and ongoing performance review. The VP collaborates closely with investment, risk, operations, compliance, and sales teams to ensure products meet regulatory standards, client needs, and profitability targets. Daily responsibilities include supervising product governance processes, managing cross-functional projects, optimizing product features based on data-driven insights, and preparing reports and presentations for senior leadership. The role also involves mentoring team members, driving process improvements, and supporting client-facing teams with product expertise and materials.
Qualifications

Strong Finance and Analytical Skills to evaluate product performance, assess risks, and support data-driven decision-making.
Proven Product Management and Product Development experience in financial services or asset management, covering the full product lifecycle.
Demonstrated Project Management skills, including leading cross-functional initiatives, managing timelines, and coordinating stakeholders.
Experience in asset management, investment products (e.g., mutual funds, ETFs, private funds), and related regulatory environments.
Ability to work effectively in a remote setting, with strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
Leadership experience managing teams or senior-level initiatives, with a focus on coaching and developing talent.
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA, FRM) are an advantage.
High level of integrity, attention to detail, and commitment to client-centric product solutions.

Executive

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Product Management and Marketing

Industries
